    SELECT b0."Id", b0."BookingId", b0."LockedInPrice", b0."RoomId", b0."RoomTypeId", r."Id" AS "Id0", r."IsActive", r."RoomNumber", r."RoomTypeId" AS "RoomTypeId0", r."RowVersion", r0."Id" AS "Id1", r0."BasePrice", r0."BedConfiguration", r0."Description", r0."ImageUrl", r0."IsActive" AS "IsActive0", r0."MaxOccupancy", r0."Name", r0."SquareFootage"
    FROM "BookingRooms" AS b0
    LEFT JOIN "Rooms" AS r ON b0."RoomId" = r."Id"
    INNER JOIN "RoomTypes" AS r0 ON b0."RoomTypeId" = r0."Id"
) AS s ON b1."Id" = s."BookingId"
ORDER BY b1."Id", s."Id", s."Id0"
